name: Assembly of Fifteen
for: An operation that never stops — multi-channel volume, quotes, orders, no-shows, lapsed customers, and money moving, all at once.

bots.why: Front-line tickets, photos read, policy checked.
Leads scored into the CRM in seconds.
Live books read on demand, writes gated.
"Where's my order?" answered from the real carrier status.
Messy job descriptions turned into itemized quotes, sent on CONFIRM.
Silent money chased on a ladder.
Tomorrow's appointments nudged at 16:00 — no-shows cut before they happen.
Customers gone quiet for 60 days get one personal, non-salesy check-in.
The phone answered on the same grounded core — spoken CONFIRM.
The same brain on RCS for the customers who aren't on WhatsApp.
Payment links issued only after a typed CONFIRM; both sides notified on payment.

notes: The three channel bots (Voice, RCS, Checkout) activate when the customer's Twilio / BSP / Stripe accounts are connected during onboarding — disclose this in the close. Everything else runs on the WhatsApp number alone.
